categories.main_business_segments: EVE Energy Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: consumer batteries (including lithium primary batteries, small lithium-ion batteries, and cylindrical batteries), power batteries (for new energy vehicles and battery systems), and energy storage batteries. These segments cover a wide range of applications such as smart meters, medical devices, 3C electronics, electric tools, electric two-wheelers, clean appliances, data center backup power, and robotics. The company also has a global cooperation business model (CLS) focusing on technology licensing, cooperative R&D, and service support.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs diverse lithium battery technologies including lithium-thionyl chloride, lithium manganese dioxide, lithium cobalt oxide, lithium iron phosphate, and ternary lithium batteries. It has developed advanced manufacturing processes such as ultra-thin lamination, 3D current collector technology, and gel-state solid-state batteries. EVE has a comprehensive R&D platform covering materials, cells, BMS, and systems, with significant investments in solid-state batteries, lithium metal secondary batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and hydrogen fuel cells. Digital twin technology and lean manufacturing are used to enhance production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: EVE serves a broad customer base across consumer electronics, automotive, industrial, and energy sectors. Key markets include smart meters, medical devices (including implantable medical devices), 3C consumer electronics, electric vehicles (passenger and commercial), energy storage systems for power grids, data centers, and marine applications. The company collaborates with leading global customers in electronic vaping, wearable devices, drones, eVTOL aircraft, and robotics, expanding into emerging markets such as low-altitude economy and green transportation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing and R&D facilities in China (including Huizhou, Jingmen, Wuhan, Chengdu, and others), Southeast Asia (Malaysia), Europe (Hungary, Germany), and North America (USA). It has established localized production bases to serve regional markets, including a large cylindrical battery plant in Malaysia and a passenger car battery project in Hungary near BMW's factory. The company’s sales cover domestic Chinese markets and international markets, with overseas sales accounting for about 24% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: EVE Energy is positioned as an integrated lithium battery manufacturer with upstream to downstream capabilities. It controls key raw material supply through investments in nickel-cobalt-lithium mining and refining, battery material production (cathode, anode, electrolyte, separator), cell manufacturing, battery module and system assembly, and battery recycling. The company emphasizes strategic supply chain security and cost management, building a resilient and green circular supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a large international R&D team and multiple research institutes. Key R&D directions include solid-state batteries, lithium metal secondary batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and hydrogen fuel cells. It focuses on enhancing energy density, safety, fast charging, and long cycle life, especially for eVTOL, robotics, medical devices, and energy storage. Digitalization of R&D, manufacturing, and management is a strategic focus to improve quality and delivery. The CLS global cooperation model supports technology licensing and joint development worldwide.
categories.revenue_model: EVE generates revenue primarily through direct sales of lithium battery products across its consumer, power, and energy storage segments. The company sells batteries and battery systems directly to OEMs and end customers. It also earns income from technology licensing and cooperative R&D under its CLS global cooperation business. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers, with no significant recurring subscription or service fees disclosed.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: EVE is a leading global lithium battery manufacturer with strong market positions in consumer batteries, power batteries for commercial vehicles, and energy storage batteries. It ranks second in the domestic commercial vehicle battery market with a 12.15% share. The company competes with other major Chinese and international battery makers by leveraging technological innovation, diversified product portfolio, global manufacturing footprint, and strategic supply chain integration. It is recognized for high-quality products and advanced safety certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, EVE reported total revenue of approximately RMB 48.6 billion, a slight decrease of 0.35% from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 4.08 billion, a 0.63% increase. The company’s energy storage segment grew significantly by 91.9% in shipment volume, while power battery shipments increased by 7.87%. Total assets reached RMB 100.9 billion, up 6.93% year-over-year. The company maintains strong R&D investment, with over RMB 3 billion spent in 2024, representing 6.29% of revenue. Cash flow from operations declined due to payment of bills, but financing activities increased substantially.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EVE emphasizes its comprehensive lithium battery technology portfolio and full-scene application solutions to accelerate the Internet of Everything. Its products are differentiated by high reliability, safety, energy density, and long cycle life, tailored for diverse applications from implantable medical devices to eVTOL aircraft and large-scale energy storage. The company’s digital twin manufacturing and lean management ensure high-quality and efficient delivery. Strategic global cooperation and supply chain integration provide resilience and competitive cost advantages, supporting sustainable growth and carbon neutrality goals.
